# SV Mail reference

Source: SV `Assets/data/UI/Mail/@MailView/Prefab/NewMailView.prefab`. The source export, original component descriptions, image references, native animation curves and adaptation inventories travel with the template.

Implemented: local inbox, stable list selection, detail/body scrolling, read state, single/batch attachment receipts, guarded deletion and empty state. This is a reference implementation, not a production mail service. Claims do not grant inventory. Inbox and receipts are in memory for the current run; an optional, clearly labelled example is loaded only when no inbox has been supplied. Example dates are rebased at first activation.

Restore `materials.json` files and adjacent meta GUIDs using the asset service. Binary resources use SHA256 IDs. `Mail/UI` contains UIMail and the two reusable list cells; `Mail/VM` contains their VMs. RuntimeSystem is a framework prerequisite; Integration/MasterSystem.cs is a route example, not permission to overwrite the product coordinator. Merge only the SYS_MAIL configuration entry and regenerate with the target exporter.

Animations: original root Open/Close, EnvelopeOpen/EnvelopeClose and EntryOpen are native clips/controllers with remapped targets. Unsupported special-item particle/mesh and RGB/active effects remain documented in the source archive. The browser card is a static shell with supported default animations; native runtime state machines and C# lists are not executed by browser preview.

Two intentional layout adaptations: hide the original capacity `/50` because this reference has no capacity policy; move the NEW badge right by 20 native units to avoid Fancy viewport clipping. Original normal/bold Chinese font faces are included for native and browser rendering. Shared native font files must be reused by matching hash or migrated through Unity tooling if the target has conflicting GUIDs.

Evidence: entity.json, flow.json, reopen-empty.json, click-claim.json, after-click.json, click-close.json and console.json. Click probes perform EventSystem raycast at the button center and dispatch a pointer click to the hit hierarchy; they are not physical mouse automation. No real service or inventory was touched. Full long-list, rapid reopen and frame-by-frame animation acceptance are recorded separately as unverified rather than inferred from source existence.


Shared reward: install RewardEntry v6 first. UIRewardEntry and VMRewardEntry live in Common/UI, not Mail. Mail owns claim rules; SyncSprite/UILoader owns icon loading. The nested reward cell and source-template visibility references are restored in Mail.prefab. See reward-migration.json for old-to-new paths.

Reward now composes ItemSlot v5. Mail assigns reward.Item.Text, reward.Item.Icon and reward.Item.IconVisible. Item.type is a host-defined integer.

Icon is a string asset path resolved by existing SyncSprite/UILoader. IconVisible expresses host visibility intent, not loading completion. Mail does not load Sprite or maintain image callbacks. Shared loader cancellation and out-of-order completion need separate validation.

tables.name: propFunctionSystem
tables.merge: Merge SYS_MAIL only, resolve product NumID collisions and regenerate using the product exporter. Never replace the complete product table.

integration: Install MailEntity and MailSystem using existing Oathx entity/system discovery. Use SystemActive/SystemDetive through the product coordinator.
Home Mail routing in Integration/MasterSystem.cs is a reference only. Do not overwrite product Master or require Home to install Mail.
Restore materials and adjacent meta GUIDs. Common font files may already exist: compare hashes before reuse; resolve conflicting GUIDs through Unity asset tooling.
MailExample.json is optional and explicitly local. Supply ReplaceInbox data before first activation to replace the example, or clear UIMail.example for an empty inbox.
Claims record in-memory receipts only. No inventory grant, service connection, persistence, timer-driven expiry or account-switch contract is provided.
Fixed labels are serialized in the prefab. Runtime fixed product messages belong in propCommonText; message bodies are host data.

Mail uses VList<VMRewardEntry> and a nested RewardEntry.prefab. Install RewardEntry v6 first; migrate old UIMailReward/VMMailReward scripts with their meta GUIDs using its migration.json. Do not keep duplicate old class files.
RewardEntry v6 requires ItemSlot v5. Mail constructs reward.Item and updates Item.Text/Icon/IconVisible; old reward Count/Icon fields no longer exist.

Icon is a string asset path resolved by existing SyncSprite/UILoader. IconVisible expresses host visibility intent, not loading completion. Mail does not load Sprite or maintain image callbacks. Shared loader cancellation and out-of-order completion need separate validation.

dependencies.name: FunctionSystemConfig
dependencies.reason: Regenerate and load the function registry before activating MailSystem.

dependencies.name: RewardEntry
dependencies.reason: Shared UIRewardEntry/VMRewardEntry, nested prefab and reward artwork; install before Mail.

# SV Shop standard reference

## Selected scope

The user selected the current SV Home mall RechargeMainView: recharge and normal gifts. The older ShopTabView and ordinary goods store are not the selected source.

Four native pages are delivered under Assets/Data/Widgets: Shop, ShopRecharge, ShopGift and ShopPurchase. Eight UIWidget/VM pairs use serialized Metadata and four real Fancy lists. ShopSystem owns lifecycle; ShopEntity owns catalog, selection, simulated balance, tokens and stock. ShopDemoCatalog supplies explicit examples only when no catalog exists.

## Installation without the source project

1. Read the standard version, scripts and configurations together. Restore materials.json resources, fetch PNG assets by ID and validate SHA256. Preserve adjacent meta GUIDs, including animations and script references.
2. Install Shop root logic, UI and VM folders. Reuse the product RuntimeSystem and CommonText rather than duplicating shared references. Register ShopEntity and ShopSystem with product identifiers.
3. Merge the 21 SHOP aliases from propCommonText and generate/load CommonText plus Language with the product exporter. The independent workbook contains only Shop rows. Preserve existing translations.
4. Ensure UISystem cancellation invalidates pending requests by identity before a late callback can instantiate a page. FrameworkReference/UISystem.cs is a reviewed reference, not a second UISystem to compile beside the installed package.
5. Route SystemActive/SystemDetive through the product coordinator. The development example routes HomeEntryRequested.Shop to Shop; this is optional integration, not a dependency on Home.
6. Open ShopSystem. Purchases are local simulations; no payment SDK, network request or actual wallet is used.

## Source pages

- Assets/data/UI/Shop/@Common/Prefab/RechargeMainView.prefab
- Assets/data/UI/Shop/@Common/Prefab/Recharge.prefab
- Assets/data/UI/Activity/@NormalGift/Prefab/NormalGiftView.prefab
- Assets/data/UI/Activity/@NormalGift/Prefab/NormalGiftBagBuyView.prefab

The source inventory records GUIDs and read-only export hashes. Source assets were not modified.

## Animation and adaptations

Default entrance curves are retained in native clips/controllers and companion design JSON: main slide/fade, category tabs, return/currency headers, product cell entrance and purchase popup scale/fade. Original gift click scale (1 to 0.9 to 1 over 0.2 seconds) is a separate native Click state with full curve JSON. Recycled product cells replay Open. Main input and product selection obey the half-second opening gate.

Transparent sprite-less Image import now preserves alpha-zero graphics instead of white overlays. Dynamic price sizes and visibility defaults are explicit. The confirmation button is widened for the simulation label and amount.

Differences and product extensions:

- Recharge normally invokes an SDK; this reference deliberately uses local confirmation.
- First-recharge promotion/bonus computation is not implemented. Source UI hooks remain; demo products do not promise a first-pay bonus.
- Wallpaper, growth fund, special-price gifts, operator recommendations, activities, remote catalogs, real payment and customer service remain extensions.
- Mesh/particle branches and inactive item-conversion RGB/active effects are excluded. This is not every SV animation or the complete operational mall.
- Browser main card represents the dynamic shell. Companion designs and native materials travel in scripts; browser preview does not execute C# list population or purchases. Unity is the functional preview.
- Image-baked title artwork remains original artwork. Dynamic fixed text comes from propCommonText.

## Verification

Compilation, isolated transaction checks and real raycast pointer actions are recorded separately from independent review. Consult packaged acceptance.json for exact results and remaining limitations; publishing does not establish acceptance.

Target: GameCLIApp p-2d314388-18c4-42f5-80eb-f6729dd23f0e; Unity identity b99aae81-c4b3-44ea-a032-a8df17831096.


## Independent product cards

Install ItemSlot v5 first. Both product cards compose the shared UIItemSlot/VMItemSlot through SyncMetadata. Icon is a string asset path resolved by SyncSprite/UILoader; Gift quantity is Item.Text.

ShopRechargeItem/ShopRechargeItem.prefab and ShopGiftItem/ShopGiftItem.prefab are independent native product cards. The Shop pages reference nested instances through Fancy.cellPrefab and ProductTemplate. Root source cells remain inactive list templates; a standalone host activates its instance after binding.

Card code stays in Shop/UI and Shop/VM. Names, prices, first-pay display, purchase limits and sold-out markers belong to card VMs; purchases belong to ShopEntity. The purchase confirmation page is unchanged.

Retain source card artwork and entrance/click animations. Shop-specific nested overrides suppress ItemSlot default backgrounds/rarity borders; recharge also suppresses the quantity and white base. Gift quantity uses dark text on the original white base. Each card keeps one outer Button and inner item Graphics do not intercept clicks.

Unref temporarily clears Item to release its child subscription, unsubscribes the card, and restores Item for list reuse. Shared SyncSprite cancellation/out-of-order behavior is not claimed as fixed by this composition.

A single reusable prefab without companion assets is stored directly in Widgets/Common/Micros. Product cards are Micros/ShopGiftItem.prefab and Micros/ShopRechargeItem.prefab. Use a module subdirectory only for multiple prefabs, Parts or companion resources.

Home reference presentation. Activity entries use FunctionSystem availability and the existing SyncGroup with a fixed ordered VList of authored UIActivityEntry items. SyncVisible controls availability and the existing layout reflows visible items. Bind once per page; update item visibility without repeated Ref. No custom list or cloned activity templates are used. Fixed navigation uses SyncMetadata and the same VMActivityEntry contract. NEW/ad widgets are instantiated only on request and released on hide or unbind; include all Badges prefabs and their resource dependencies. New artwork requires an authored item and matching configuration. Function inputs are local events, with no server implementation. Framework files are merge references only. Merge the WidgetMetadataInspector compatibility fix: serialized sync type names are authoritative; stale hash caches must never rewrite bindings when selecting a widget. Fixed Text values are serialized in the prefab without Entity or VM forwarding; only player, level, currencies and chat remain dynamic text bindings. Unimplemented activity placeholders remain empty. The retained propCommonText entries are localization source material, not a runtime Home dependency; language switching needs a UI localization component. Local example data restores nine source activity entries, independent composable NEW/ad widgets; notification dots are owned by the RedDotSystem template and propRedDot and a Triple reward state. Replace HomeEntity values for the product and call HomeSystem.Refresh. Retain source fonts, HomeTextOutline, the serialized outline shader reference and its UGUI clipping compatibility fix, activity GridLayoutGroup and serialized entry badge mounts. NEW and drop animations loop separately; entrance includes Left. Merge only configurations entries. No live ad SDK or activity service is implemented. Character and seasonal presentation remain extension points. The source screenshot is an example, not an active operations schedule. Production materials include native font originals and browser WOFF2 derivatives. Static source-layout equality intentionally reports the migrated marker nodes: their graphics now live in optional badge prefabs, and their pulse scale moved from mounts to badge roots. Validate the compiled bindings, entry-badges.json references and runtime attach/release evidence separately; do not report the static comparison as passed.

tables.name: propCommonText
tables.merge: Merge these Home aliases only. Resolve numeric collisions before generation; preserve product data and translations.

integration: HomeEntity must be registered with the entity manager.
RuntimeSystem.LoadSystem must activate newly created inactive modules for explicit navigation, independently of startup Active configuration.
Register HomeSystem in the product FunctionSystem table using the existing product ID allocation; do not copy a reference numeric ID.
The product coordinator consumes HomeEntryRequested; all destinations remain unconnected in this basic reference.
HomePresentationRequested exposes optional keys; no Spine, season animation, remote activity or SDK implementation is included.

Function availability: merge the included Function sources and SYS_FUNCTION_OPEN startup row. Conditions use {Switch:1,Level:10}; UTC time windows are inclusive-start/exclusive-end. Empty ClassType is presentation-only. Each nonempty ClassType is unique. Merge the reference GamePlugin.Load gate and MasterSystem event handlers without replacing product files. Home authored items bind stable FunctionSystem IDs through existing SyncGroup and SyncVisible; retain local artwork, animations and per-item RedDotScope.

Currency component: install CurrencyBar template v2 before Home, preserving native asset GUIDs. Home embeds its nested CurrencyBar.prefab and supplies three VMCurrencyEntry values and callbacks once. Update existing Amount properties when refreshing. No Currency source or materials are duplicated in Home.

Profile widgets: install PlayerProfile v4 bundle before Home. It carries Profile and ProfileShortcuts as two composite roots; avatar and individual buttons are internal Parts. Shared code lives in Common/UI. Bind the five shortcut entries through one VMProfileShortcuts; preserve Common resource GUIDs. Keep all GUIDs. Home supplies one VMProfile for name, level, portrait, frame and two entry interactions; all inner bindings belong to UIProfile. Valid asset paths are supplied by the host and loaded through SyncSprite; PortraitVisible and FrameVisible use SyncVisible. The component does not query HomeEntity.

dependencies.name: propLanguage
dependencies.reason: Generate with the product exporter and load CommonText/Language before opening Home.

# SV Settings reference

Source: `Assets/data/UI/Set/@SetView/Prefab/SetSystemView.prefab` from the SV reference. Five tabs retain the original layout and static Chinese labels. Materials contain the resolved source archive, image resources, native prefab, font references, source animation clips/controllers and mapping inventory.

The template owns 30 device preferences: graphics tiers, independent channel levels and mute switches, local gameplay/chat/privacy/push preferences and download network policy. SettingsEntity validates and saves these values. Unknown or malformed persisted values fall back to defaults; snapshots do not expose mutable owned state. A medium graphics preset maps the original two-level model control to Low. Custom is derived from the individual tiers, not a separate preset.

SettingsChanged publishes the local snapshot; the product applies audio mixer levels, SV-specific rendering effects, gameplay, server privacy and OS notification policies. No original SDK, URL, renderer, network stack, account deletion, account switch or actual download is installed. SettingsActionRequested forwards those original service entries without claiming a successful service result. Applications should apply restored preferences during startup, independently of opening the page. The page's initial notification also provides a snapshot to consumers already subscribed.

The original root clip animates the Sound page's headset when selected; the BackGather clip animates the return/title area. Both native clips are preserved through UnityCLI and replayed at the corresponding lifecycle point. Browser preview supports the default BackGather entrance only and does not execute C# preferences or service requests.

Explicit conversion differences: the inactive empty StaticList with negative source width is excluded. Tab mesh/particle glow branches remain archived rather than being silently represented as UGUI animation curves; selected tab artwork is retained. Unknown product server name is blank. Platform-hidden source rows and the account-transfer modal stay hidden, with their controls retained for product adaptation. Static text language switching is not wired; dynamic product messages must use propCommonText.

Install scripts under Settings, RuntimeSystem and the existing shared StorageKey helper; reuse existing identical shared helpers instead of defining duplicate types. Restore materials with adjacent meta GUIDs and verify SHA256. Shared Common fonts must be compared before reuse. Merge SYS_SETTINGS from the configuration package and regenerate with the target exporter; do not overwrite the whole product workbook. Integration/MasterSystem.cs illustrates optional Home routing and must not replace a product coordinator.

Development and acceptance skills are siblings under skills/oathx/system/settings. Runtime test probes are evidence only and are excluded from the template code package. Reports distinguish static review, native compilation, UI/animation observations and remaining unverified behavior.

Regional reference: the Chinese CnBox/CnBox_2 service groups are visible; the overlapping overseas Box (transfer code, account binding, AI help) remains archived and inactive by default. SV switches these groups through regional function/account predicates. Products must select the intended variant instead of activating both. Native function scrolling retains RectMask2D and graphics scrolling retains Mask with showMaskGraphic=false.

Revision 2 removes the Tencent customer-service entry and RiceRoll, Power, Weekend and HeadquartersMatch notification preferences at the user request. The current native/browser nodes and bindings exclude them. Original source archives are historical evidence only. Remaining preference/action enum numbers are stable; deleted string/numeric keys are ignored individually during restore.

Revision 3 also removes ExtremeTrain and HomeDaily notifications and the now-empty GridPushMessage container. Thirty preferences remain; numeric identifiers 10 through 15 stay unassigned and are ignored when restoring old saved values.

integration: SettingsEntity owns local device preferences. Restore materials and meta GUIDs and compile the Widget source generator.
SettingsChanged supplies an independent snapshot to product audio/render/gameplay adapters. Saving an option does not implement SV-specific effects, remote privacy state or OS push registration.
SettingsActionRequested is an explicit unimplemented product service entry. No SDK, external URL, account deletion, account switching or resource download is executed.
Merge SYS_SETTINGS only. Master Home routing is an optional reference, not a requirement to install Home or overwrite product coordination.
Fixed Chinese labels and fonts are on the prefab. Runtime product messages belong in propCommonText. Language switching is not wired in this reference.
The source tab glow mesh/particle branches and dormant empty StaticList remain archived; active UGUI controls and both source animation clips are restored.
